gloss_en: Regel — the noun 'foot' (singular of raglayim), the lowest limb; used as a homiletic hub in Likutey Moharan for whatever stands at the 'lowest level' or 'carries' a person: counsel/advice ('kol ha-am asher be-raglekha' = those following your counsel), commerce/travel for business ('semach Zevulun be-tzetekha'), prayer, wealth ('ha-yekum asher be-ragleihem'), the wife ('raglei chasidav yishmor'), and — via the cognate verb ragal/nirgan — slander and strife ('lo ragal al leshono'). Distinct from רֶגֶל 'pilgrimage festival', הֶרְגֵּל 'habit', or רָגִיל 'accustomed'.
